description: Geomorfología Urbana - Insumo Estudios Básicos de Amenaza por Movimientos en Masa. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Distrital de Gestión de Riesgos y Cambio Climático - IDIGER. Capa Geográfica con la geomorfología obtenida por el IDIGER mediante consultorías, como parte de los estudios básicos para la identificación de la Amenaza por Movimientos en Masa a escala 1:5000 del área urbana de la ciudad de Bogotá. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto Distrital de Gestión de Riesgos y Cambio Climático - IDIGER. Its tags are Cambio Climático, Deslizamiento, Geología, Geomorfología, Gestión del riesgo. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2023-12-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
